race.comment: INCOHERENT (8) loomed up before straightening at Sale last start but didn't have the change of gears required and finished midfield at the end of 1200m. That was a far stronger maiden than this so over an extra 100m she can certainly turn things around. FIRE TYPE (5) is back after a six-month spell. Has been in the money at four of eight runs to date, including his only visit to Ararat. Three recent trials should have him ready to run well. MODEL GIGI (10) led for home but couldn't maintain the effort and dropped off to finish fifth recently over 1200m at Mornington. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and might need this trip now. DIMACHAERUS (4) was too bad to be true here last start but a tinkering of the gear might help turn things around. TYPHOON BASSETT (6) returns from a 38-week spell for a new stable. Didn't fire in the maiden prep but will probably find this a little easier.
